en.headline: Observatory issues Yellow Fire Danger Warning as risk rises
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6am on Sunday, warning that the fire risk is high.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6:00am on Sunday, stating that the fire risk is high. The warning remains in force.
The Observatory said the yellow signal means the fire danger is quite high. Members of the public are urged to take extra care to prevent fires, and hikers should be particularly vigilant.
No other weather warnings are currently in force. At 7am, the temperature at the Observatory was 22 degrees Celsius with relative humidity at 84 per cent.

zh.headline: 天文台今早發出黃色火災危險警告 火災風險顏高
zh.dek: 香港天文台周日上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性顇高。
body: 香港天文台周日上午6時正發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性顇高，警告現時仍生效。
天文台表示，黃色警告代表火災危險性顇高。市民應特別提高警覺，並確保採取適當防火措施，遠足人士亦應多加注意。
現時無其他天氣警告生效。早上7時，天文台錄得氣溫為攝氏22度，相對濕度為百分之八十四。
